findings.fix:
Options: (a) replace line 39 with the report's description of where the standing is actually written; (b) lift "carried, not repaired" and give LEDGER.md and the staging register copyright labels in their Label column. Pick (a). Replace line 39 of L7/governance/copyright/0.md with:
**Where a source's standing is written.** In the pre-restructure register, `L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/sources__LEDGER.md`: the Access column carries `PAYWALLED` and the licence constraint on IEEE Std 7001-2021, 1788-2015 and 7009-2024; the Label column carries `COPYRIGHT-BLOCK` on one row, `INST-OECD-AIP8-2024`. `L7/provenance/sources/LEDGER.md` carries no copyright label: its Label column holds the document class, its Access column reads `HELD` on every row, and the hold note on rows S-095 to S-097 stands in the Citation cell. result.notes: Of the 28 findings, 22 are best applied, 3 need the owner's choice and 3 are best left. Every finding's text was checked in the export of aybllc/auditonomous main at aa30b03, and each one is still there; nothing in the repositories was changed. The 22 fixes to apply edit 16 live sheets of aybllc/auditonomous and nothing else. They change no path, no sheet's first line and no rule, and they touch no record, retired set, binder gate file, definition, ledger row or third-party text. If the owner takes the pick for the publications sheet, that makes a 17th sheet. Each fix still waits for the owner's yes. The scaffold's record says "No outside updates until we are sure I'm close" (7lm main 6de996b, L8/L6/history/harmonization-2026-09-04.md:336), and its §36 makes every finding a proposal. The owner's words of 11 November, "Get qa hanfle on the research and manuscruipt for Auditonomous but firwst" (aybllc/auditonomous main aa30b03, L8/L6/history/harmonization-2026-09-05.md:178), put this checking after the match. A yes therefore stands as the owner's word for one pass, made by hand, with a new §14 in that record. Dates follow the repository's own rule of 7 September 2026 (its record, §11). The fixes take out "this pass" where it was the sheets' own past, and they add dates only to observations and to records. Four of the report's fixes are corrected here. In L8/L5/research/0.md:38 the report would have put back a date that the 7 September pass took out, so the dangling words are deleted instead. For L8/0.md:137 the fix on L8/L4/work/ is corrected because the .docx files are sourcebook volumes, not transcripts. The other two corrections are punctuation, in L7/0.md:232 and at line 88 of L8/L6/0.md. The report prints "L8/0.md:137" as the heading of three findings, one stale and two unlisted; they are given here in the report's order and are made in one edit. Two fixes share line 88 of L8/L6/0.md. Four fixes share a line with a WRONG-FACT finding of the same report but do not overlap with it: L7/0.md:232, L7/provenance/sources/0.md:10, L8/L6/history/0.md:35 and L8/L4/work/writing/chat/0.md:16. L8/L1/0.md:54 and L8/L4/0.md:100 are the scaffold's own text and are false in all three repositories, including on the reconcile commit of pull request #19. The scaffold should be corrected first and the two exemplars then given the same words. The same stale phrases stand in aybllc/autonomous main at L7/allications/publications/binder/0.md:8, L7/peering/private/ingress/peer-1/0.md:8, L7/peering/private/ingress/peer-1/object-1/0.md:13, L7/provenance/sources/0.md:10, L8/0.md:137, L8/L1/0.md:54, L8/L4/0.md:100, L8/L5/research/0.md:40, L8/L6/0.md:88 and 91, and L8/L6/history/0.md:41. Three of these are not in that repository's audit: L8/L4/0.md:100, L8/L5/research/0.md:40 and L8/L6/0.md:91. For binder/0.md:8 and sources/0.md:10, that audit's fixes add a date where these fixes do not. Using these words in both exemplars keeps them alike and within the same rule, which aybllc/autonomous carries as §12 of its record. The scaffold's own L7/provenance/sources/0.md:10 has the same kind of leftover ("relocated in this pass"). The branch beta/7lm-exemplar-auditonomous (714480d) carries, unchanged, every sentence that the 17 dead-path, stale and misquote fixes change. Whichever of this pass and that branch lands second must take the same edits. Pull request #28 changes no sheet; if it is merged first, its agent-results-2026-11-11/ folder joins the list at L8/L5/0.md line 80. The three dead-path fixes mark removed paths as removed, as the same sheets already do elsewhere. They touch none of the binder files, staging READMEs, ledgers or manuscript that decision 23 of the owner-decision resolutions of 11 November is about.

result.notes:
One owner choice decides 46 of the 50 findings, all in Auditonomous files: is a record that misstates its public source corrected in place, or left as written with the correction filed beside it? Pick: beside, in one new dated record per repository at L8/L6/history/source-corrections-2026-11-11.md. The reasons for that place: both exemplars' L6 history sheets hold corrections with the prior state retained, and Auditonomous's sources sheet (aa30b03 L7/provenance/sources/0.md line 37) assigns the history of when a source was corrected to L8/L6/history/. In addition, one line goes in the Holdings of each folder sheet whose file is corrected, saying the file is cited as written and where its corrections are. That way no correction is a one-way pointer, the defect named in aybllc/autonomous main 9fa3744, L8/L6/history/AUDIT_L3_CORRECTION_CHAIN.md line 13.

Why beside, by the repositories' own practice. They correct a record in place only on the day it is written: the reading records of 4 August (commit e9b7a26), and the same-day second commits at the ends of Auditonomous record section 13 and scaffold section 41. Later work is corrected beside it, leaving the earlier text: "Corrections to this record, stated here and left in place there." (aybllc/7lm main 6de996b, L8/L6/history/harmonization-2026-09-04.md line 506). Auditonomous section 8 likewise supersedes sections 4d and 6 without editing them. The staging records' folder says "its files are not edited" (aa30b03 L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/0.md line 8). The same rule appears in the 16 August ledger (lines 31 and 50, the latter for the definition) and in Auditonomous record sections 7, 10 and 13. The definitions sheet already records a pending edit beside the definition and cites it as written (line 32). The SP 800-53 extraction's own header admits no commentary inside it. The alternative, in place with a dated note, is the practice of 4 August, used only on the day of writing.

The pass in Auditonomous is made by hand, with no script (record section 39), in this order:
(1) Write the correction record: 46 entries grouped by file. Each gives the file and line, what it says, the issuing body's words taken afresh from its own document (nvlpubs.nist.gov, csrc.nist.gov, www.rfc-editor.org) with a locator, and the corrected statement.
(2) Add one line each to the Holdings of L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/0.md (lines 18 and 20, since library/reading/ and standards/extracted/ have no sheet), L8/L4/work/computation/0.md (line 40), L8/L5/research/findings/0.md (line 36), L8/L1/state-space/0.md (line 38) and L8/L0/semantics/definitions/0.md (line 32), and an entry in L8/L6/history/0.md.
(3) Make step 1 of sp800-53-7: line 44 of the computation sheet.
(4) Add section 14 to L8/L6/history/harmonization-2026-09-05.md.
The sheet audit's fixes to the staging-records sheet are at lines 8 and 30, so the two batches do not collide.

Tally: 48 owner-chooses (the 46 above, plus 2 in Autonomous that wait), 2 leave, 0 apply. The only live-sheet sentence among the 50 is line 44 of the computation sheet (step 1 of sp800-53-7). Its new wording is true whatever is chosen for the records, so it can also go into the apply pass on its own.

Autonomous. Record section 26 holds the owner's rule that no outside update is made until the owner is sure the scaffold is close. The owner's word of 11 November opened Autonomous only for the mirror, which is done. Its two definition items therefore wait. One owner choice decides 46 of the 50 findings, all in Auditonomous files: is a record that misstates its public source corrected in place, or left as written with the correction filed beside it? Pick: beside, in one new dated record per repository at L8/L6/history/source-corrections-2026-11-11.md. Why beside, by the repositories' own practice. They correct a record in place only on the day it is written: the reading records of 4 August (commit e9b7a26), and the same-day second commits at the ends of Auditonomous record section 13 and scaffold section 41. Later work is corrected beside it, leaving the earlier text: "Corrections to this record, stated here and left in place there." (aybllc/7lm main 6de996b, L8/L6/history/harmonization-2026-09-04.md line 506). Auditonomous section 8 likewise supersedes sections 4d and 6 without editing them.
